title: GY control TagDuel adapter — The End of Anubis + Kycoo the Ghost Destroyer

cards.name: The End of Anubis
cards.officialText: All cards and effects that target a card(s) in the GY or that activate in the GY are negated.

cards.name: Kycoo the Ghost Destroyer
cards.officialText: When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can target up to 2 monsters in their GY; banish those targets. Your opponent cannot banish cards from either GY.

testCoverage: The End of Anubis globally negates effects that activate in the GY or target a GY card, but not unrelated effects
The End of Anubis must remain face-up; face-down copies do not apply
Kycoo prevents the opposing team from banishing cards from either shared GY while allowing its controller team
Face-down Kycoo does not apply its continuous restriction
Kycoo's optional trigger requires positive battle damage in the controller team's battle window
The target pool contains only opposing GY monsters and includes cards owned by an inactive partner
Banishment preserves physical UIDs and the inventory multiset
Duplicate, foreign and more-than-two target selections are rejected
Targets that leave the GY before resolution are ignored without duplicating UIDs
The End of Anubis negates Kycoo's GY-targeting effect at resolution
Zero selected targets do not mutate inventory
A seven-card hand remains intact until the End Phase; the adapter does not discard early
A team with more than three Monster Zones is rejected
fixtureStrategy: Production defaults retain the two official card IDs. Because these candidates are not yet admitted to the engine-v9 playable catalog, tests inject two already-playable Normal Monster IDs as temporary aliases. Aliases are test-only and do not change metadata, certificates, allowlist, catalog, or player inventory.
limitations: M61 still owns the protected resolver, metadata and certification files; this PR adds an isolated adapter only.
The new card IDs are not yet playable/certified in engine-v9; adapter tests use fixture aliases and do not count as engine-v9 certification.
No live Discord gateway/guild, production database, merge, deploy or backup restoration was exercised.
